text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be<n>taking on the
Twinkle Series. The<n>Umamusume joining me for
this<n>journey is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Boy, runnin' sure is a hoot! ♪ And<n>so's watchin'
races! ♪ That's why<n>I'm out to happify everyone
with my<n>racin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's have ourselves a shindig<n>to celebrate us
gettin' started! Every<n>start's an art, after all! All
righty, let's<n>buckle to it, pardner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps<n>towards
competing in the Twinkle<n>Series!
